name: agent-crew phase 1 validation framework
objective: Validate first-phase readiness across repository-level tests, deterministic workflow simulations, and operator-facing evaluation criteria.

levels.description: Fast deterministic Python coverage for validators, parsers, routing helpers, telemetry, memory safeguards, and cost aggregation.
Shell-level CLI and hook smokes that exercise setup, routing, status rendering, guards, and local memory wrappers.
Repository integration scenarios covering fake-host E2E flow, SSOT round-trip, status rendering, quality gates, and runtime enforcement.
Deterministic workflow simulations for task routing, pipeline validation, progress/state artifacts, retry behavior, and non-destructive recovery.
Operator-readiness checks for latency SLOs, telemetry, memory retrieval, and cost impact under feasible local conditions.

criteria.question: Does agent-crew avoid adding noticeable startup/runtime overhead to ordinary AI interactions and workflow commands?
criteria.phase_1_threshold: All required latency checks pass their fixture budgets or produce an actionable failure.

criteria.question: Does agent-crew preserve or improve response quality and task-processing quality?
criteria.phase_1_threshold: Required quality and replay checks pass.

criteria.question: Does the system clearly communicate progress while workflows are running?
criteria.phase_1_threshold: Status and progress rendering checks pass.

criteria.question: Does the system persist, recall, and reuse useful context beyond short-lived session context?
criteria.phase_1_threshold: Required memory safeguards pass; retrieval eval is recorded when local memory state is available.

criteria.question: Are workflow routing and validation outcomes repeatable and stable?
Are logs, status artifacts, evidence, and diagnostics sufficient to explain workflow state?
criteria.phase_1_threshold: Required status, telemetry, and state checks pass.

criteria.question: Do interrupted or failed workflows resume or report actionable recovery steps?
criteria.phase_1_threshold: Required recovery and retry simulations pass.

criteria.question: Do supported host and workflow paths behave consistently in feasible in-repo tests?
Do tested paths avoid unsafe destructive behavior and obvious secret or permission risks?
criteria.phase_1_threshold: Required guard and approval checks pass.

criteria.question: Is workflow overhead measurable, bounded, and explainable?
criteria.phase_1_threshold: Required cost/telemetry checks pass and report no unexplained overhead.

conclusion_rules.required_command_failure: Criterion is needs_attention when any non-optional command mapped to it fails.
conclusion_rules.optional_command_failure: Criterion remains provisional when only optional commands fail or are skipped.
conclusion_rules.unmeasured: Criterion is unmeasured when no command maps to it.
